facts.fact: Business Focus reports that the Minister for ICT and National Guidance, under the Data Protection and Privacy Act, Cap. 97, appointed Baker Birikujja as Uganda's National Personal Data Protection Director.

systems.owner: Ministry of ICT and National Guidance

facts.fact: Business Focus reports that the ICT Minister appointed Baker Birikujja National Personal Data Protection Director of the Personal Data Protection Office under the Data Protection and Privacy Act, Cap. 97.
Business Focus reports the appointment was made under the Data Protection and Privacy Act, Cap. 97 and its Regulations, and the Office is to promote compliance with the Act.
